text_block_list.text: One day, at a certain live venue—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it's just a guest appearance, it's your first stage.
How are you holding up, alright? Want some water?

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... No worries!
I'm gonna go out there and entertain everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Look at you... Fufu, what a great expression!
Knock 'em dead!

text_block_list.name: Audience Member A
text_block_list.text:
Opening act? Just some unknown girl, huh~.
Guess I'll go grab a drink while I can.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(...Give it your all.
All I can do now is watch over you—)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, King! You came to listen?
I'm so glad to see you interested♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai?!
I-It's not as though I'm particularly interested or anything—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's just that you broadcast it over the PA every single day,
so I wondered what sort of song it was... and, well...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look! A first-class lady must maintain
an appreciation for all diverse kinds of music—

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, there aren't really enough people to need to project my voice.
Still, I'll sing from the bottom of my heart. Because...
I want to tell everyone to 'keep looking forward'!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu, you'll definitely understand
what that girl is all about now.

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Is there a concert going on?
—Who's singing? Kinda...

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text: FIGHT ONNNN!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this is ridiculously good...!
I'm getting so hyped up!
Seriously awesomeee!!

'Even when it hurts, keep looking forward.'
The girl's passionate voice lit a fire of inspiration
in everyone's hearts...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How was it?
That soul-stirring shout of hers!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hah... It's way too noisy, or rather,
it's very much the kind of music you'd love, Pearl-senpai.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...A song that shamelessly knocks
right on the door of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course I love it!
...But that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I wanted all the effort and struggle she poured into singing
for passing strangers to finally be rewarded.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...
But isn't that just—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A sweet fairytale, yes. Even when you give your best,
more often than not, it doesn't come true... That is reality.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yet, you see... precisely because I know both the nobility
and the futility of effort, I choose to cheer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...You know it too, don't you?
That such a voice can become the power to sustain someone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When you feel like giving up, that's when you raise your voice.
When you're about to crumble, that's when you push forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To shatter the reality of broken dreams,
I'll keep cheering on every ounce of effort!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The one who cheers and the one who is cheered on are two sides of the same coin—
No, they're surely a reflection in the mirror.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Heh... So that's why.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To think her song... felt as though
she were singing about me...
One day, while walking in front of the station—

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Guitar
text_block_list.text:
I wanna write a song themed around you, Pearl-san!
It feels like it could really empower people chasing their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very nice!
A world-changing, big Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come, let's aim for it!
A song that will give courage to the entire world!

If it's these two, they can definitely do it.
My heart raced with that very premonition!
